dataset_use_case_qualification.requirement: Qualified tool/model waits and safety semantics, family-isolated temporal splits, complete selection denominators for the intended scheduling workload.

native_capture_integrity.requirement: Complete PostgreSQL Coordinator admission demand, capacity-rejection/retry, CreateActor/ResumeActor RPC, ready and release chains; runtime receipts and cross-producer identities on the target MEMORY runtime, with measured capture overhead. Historical FairSlots captures retain their legacy runner-admission scope.

physical_cost_calibration.requirement: Target-environment MEMORY lifecycle, RSS/charge and device I/O, failures and concurrency; held-out calibration error.

closed_loop_DAG_validation.requirement: Live-runner parent delay, joins, restore queue propagation, terminal-turn sensitivity and runtime calibration.

complete_online_feature_lineage.requirement: Each deployed decision input has producer, available_at, consumer, source frontier and training cutoff; restored runtime identity is issued externally.

independent_statistical_design.requirement: Frozen primary metrics, complete planned/offered denominators, family/time holdout, paired runner units, failure treatment and calibration tolerance.
